newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade active $106/dressed-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade active $106/dressed-USDA.

text.p: Trade Wednesday was active on slaughter cattle, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis $0.50-$1.00 lower than last week; dressed basis steady with the decline on Tuesday. Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest good until CME closed higher.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00; Dressed basis 105.00-106.00. (weighted average 105.65).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00; Dressed basis 105.00-106.00. (weighted average 105.68). Confirmed - 31,800 Last Week - 11,300 Last Year - 30,200
For The Wk - 52,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 83,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 39,000
